title: Slow cooling vs quenching
sub: Minimize the energy. Same landscape, same start, same number of steps. Only the cooling schedule differs.

Ended in the deepest valley. Over 200 runs from the same start, slow cooling found it 84% of the time: hot enough early to cross barriers, cooled slowly enough to settle in the right place.
